A police officer tries to change his younger brother, who turns to a life of crime, but he fails. He then takes on the local gangster responsible for inciting youngsters towards crime.
When a sharp investigating officer based in Mumbai named Maddy goes to Kerala to look for a missing girl, he uncovers a dangerous sex trafficking scheme.
An astute sub-inspector relentlessly pursues a malicious serial killer who victimises vulnerable adolescent girls. Therefore, this probe incurs severe consequences.
A law officer and research scholar investigate an ancient Indian temple's enigmas, tracking scriptures and folklore. Thus, they uncover deity secrets and hidden forest treasure.
An undercover police officer takes on a mission to take down a crime lord but soon finds himself in a difficult situation when he learns that the crime lord's business intentions are good.
